title: Greenleaf Café ordering test
welcome: Hi, I'm Sam. Thanks for helping us test our new ordering site. I'll talk you through four short tasks, one at a time. There are no wrong answers. We're testing the site, not you.

tasks.title: Find your previous bookings
tasks.say: Have a look around and find your previous bookings

tasks.title: Add an oat milk flat white to your basket
tasks.say: Choose a flat white, make it with oat milk, and add it to your basket.

tasks.title: Change the collection time to 12:30
tasks.say: You can only pick your order up at half past twelve. Change the collection time to match.

tasks.title: Go to checkout, but stop before paying
tasks.say: Head to the checkout. When you reach the payment page, stop there.

thanks: Your answers help us fix the confusing bits before the site goes live.
